focusProtocol.delayedKey: Final leaf key and j use one XTEST batch, with no provider/command/focus wait between them.

focusProtocol.configure: Record the initial five-second dialog interval, then select Configure and observe a separate five-second follow-up. Do not relabel the dialog as the first input destination.
